question: Are actual observable four A-probe causal factors statistically sufficient to learn action-contingent realized reward, and is weak causal return learning due to feature composition or reward-objective conditioning? Compare same 4,801-parameter fully trained MLP with raw A cues vs explicit publicly composed A-sign product, each direct or TRAIN-only action-mean residual targets, versus a role/time/action-preserving cross-world composed-cue shuffled negative. No hidden-law or oracle supervised labels.
null: If composed public-cue predictors do not reproducibly beat shuffled factual-evidence controls or TRAIN-only action constant on new DEV and shifted OOD, the observable causal signal transfer hypothesis fails. If feature signal works but residualization does not beat direct-value learning, record separate FEATURE_SIGNAL_ONLY, not an optimizer or native learning advance. Nothing herein proves independent native TTT learning, unfamiliar causal-law transfer, generalization beyond same-family synthetic OOD, or GPU efficacy.

sources.world_generator: Only R85 _make_synthetic_world(index%512, Generator(SeedSequence([panel_salt,seed,index]))) and R86 pure shift _shift_public_world in OOD; never R85-R93 admitted/scored _world, prior test fixture or old trained weights.
sources.actual_logged_action: CALIBRATE iff ((floor(index/4)+seed_index)%2==0), else EXPLOIT_POS; index-only action assignment balanced in 8 cells of pivot (i%2) x private law index-stratum ((i%512)//2)%2 x chosen action, preflight WITHOUT accessing physical worlds; private law never learner input/label.
sources.train_factual_only: One physically realized selected 9-tick action return per independent FIT/VALID world, never both outcomes or future observation; no model-training on law label, parity teacher, private oracle or DEV/OOD outcomes.
sources.public_observation: R86 48x13 legal public selected timeline; R87 _legal_features selects FOUR actually observed noisy A PROBE responses in public role order, actual selected pivot action flags, public timestamp, no engineered parity in RAW; COMPOSED replaces four raw cues by one explicit deterministic product of observed cue signs, held in first of 8D MLP slots; engineered composition is a supplied diagnostic feature NOT autonomously learned.
sources.DEV_scoring: Only after all five arms complete full training and freeze. Actual evaluator physically realizes both legal interventions for same new physical DEV world and constructs action-specific legal public prefixes. No alternate-action return used in FIT/VALID. Compare paired policy realized reward, legal rule agreement, physical oracle regret, paired bootstrap, and cold early breakdown.
sources.OOD_scope: Same physical four-factor law, changed probe schedule/pivot/noise via preexisting pure R86 shift; NOT genuinely unfamiliar causal laws.

method.all_MLP_same_class: Existing R87 PublicValueMLP, 8D->64->64->1, identical 4,801 params, same torch-seeded initial tensors in every arm, only feature and factual objective differ.
method.residual_target: actual physically observed selected return - TRAIN-only mean of actual factual returns for the same chosen action; at inference add back that fixed TRAIN-only action mean. No DEV mean, no alternate action, no teacher.
method.composed_feature: Only index of four A responses selected from actually public prefix. r87._legal_features deterministic sign product of noisy A factor cues, 4 raw feature slots replaced by (A-sign product,0,0,0). Private true law not accessed.
method.shuffled_negative: Cross-world permutation of composed A-sign feature within observed pivot-time AND chosen-action strata, independent of private law, no change to current action or physical factual return; same 8D input and 4,801 params as real composition, train/dev/ood shuffled with independent fixed per-panel RNG.
method.trained_controls: Fully trained direct and TRAIN-centered residual raw MLP variants, composed direct MLP, composed residual, composed shuffled residual. All arms identical FIT factual worlds, same ordered minibatch indices, updates, optimizer and parameter counts.
method.train_observed_action_baseline: Action-specific FIT factual sample means only; fixed predictor when scoring paired DEV/OOD choices and factual MSE. Must not use heldout targets for any training decision.

training.validation: FIT_VALIDATION MSE logged before/after but no selection/stop, no scoring DEV/OOD before all arm weights frozen
training.source_first_use: Original exact-head clean GitHub-hosted Ubuntu PR G4 GATED two original seed jobs, FIRST ATTEMPT only, no replay
